attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: one original-size-compatible Hearts of Iron IV character portrait replacement.
Image 1 is the original HOI4 portrait and composition target. Image 2 is the user's exact 奶龙 identity reference: a smooth golden-yellow round creature with green rings around black eyes, a small horizontal mouth and creamy belly.
Replace the human head, body and exposed human skin with this recognizable yellow mascot. RETAIN the original person's visible hairstyle, hairline, hair color, eyebrows, moustache, beard and sideburns as distinguishing features attached to the mascot, adapting them to its round head. Match the original's parting, thickness, curls and facial-hair shape. Preserve a bald scalp or clean-shaven face only where the original actually has one. Do not invent hair hidden under a hat.
Preserve the original clothing, uniform, headgear, glasses, decorations, accessories, expression, gaze, pose, action, framing, scale, lighting, background and painterly color treatment. No new hats, uniforms, medals or symbols. Use only visually present features; do not infer appearance from filenames or historical biographies.
Keep the yellow creature's anatomy, large green-ringed black eyes and small horizontal mouth; do not restore human skin, human nose or human ears. Express the original mood through its creature eyes and mouth plus retained eyebrows.
Preserve the source aspect ratio, crop and number of figures. Preserve real alpha transparency, photographic frames, note cards and existing decorative markings where present. Do not add such framing where absent. Polished painterly HOI4 finish, legible at the original in-game size. One source image to one asset. No comparison board, new text, label, watermark or extra figure.

Visible source-specific features: Bareheaded with very short black hair, receding hairline and thick dark eyebrows. Match the small dark upper-lip facial-hair shape actually visible in the original, ABOVE the mouth; do not invent a chin beard or heavy sideburns. Plain dark gray high-collar tunic, frontal bust, original transparency outside silhouette.
Output alpha: keep a genuine fully transparent RGBA background outside the portrait silhouette. No painted gray backdrop, halo, studio gradient or rectangular plate. Retain the source's clothing, hair, headgear and portrait crop.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actual exact original and unchanged current raw master compared on source/white/cyan/alpha page: the original has a continuous near-opaque cream/beige/grey painted rectangular backdrop, but the returned portrait deletes it into a transparent figure cutout. Restore the actual original full-canvas painted background, texture, vignette and lighting through the builtin image tool. Preserve actual figure pose, hair/facial hair, accessories, source clothing and decoration footprints/counts, crop and fitted short broad neckline. No programmatic fill, invented studio background, frame or note.
